settings.heading: Frequently asked questions
settings.text: Answers to the things people ask us most.

settings.question: What is Kusho?
settings.answer: Kusho is an Indian comfort-focused brand offering premium memory foam pillows and cushions designed to give you the comfort you deserve.

settings.question: What materials are used in Kusho products?
settings.answer: Kusho products use high-quality memory foam, latex foam, PU foam, and durable, breathable fabrics for comfort and support.

settings.question: Are Kusho products washable?
settings.answer: The memory foam core is not washable, but all Kusho products come with a removable, machine-washable cover for easy cleaning and maintenance.

settings.question: Are Kusho pillows hypoallergenic?
settings.answer: Yes. Kusho pillows are hypoallergenic, dust-mite resistant, and safe for people with sensitive skin or allergies.

settings.question: Is Cash on Delivery available on Kusho.in?
settings.answer: COD and online payments are available on Kusho.in, depending on delivery serviceability.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Standard delivery usually takes 3–7 working days. Delivery timelines may vary slightly depending on location and unforeseen circumstances.

settings.question: Can Kusho products be returned or replaced?
settings.answer: Yes, Kusho products can be replaced if damaged or defective, according to the website’s return policy

settings.question: Are Kusho products good for gifting?
settings.answer: Yes. Kusho memory foam pillows and cushions are thoughtful, premium, and health-focused gifts, perfect for people of all ages.

settings.question: How can I contact Kusho for support?
settings.answer: You can reach us anytime through: ; Email: support@kusho.in ; Website: www.kusho.in (Contact Us section)

settings.question: Do Kusho pillows help with neck and back pain?
settings.answer: Yes. They support your neck and spine to reduce pressure and keep you comfortable while sleeping, sitting, or travelling.

settings.question: Are Kusho pillows suitable for all sleeping positions?
settings.answer: Kusho pillows are thoughtfully designed to support side, back, and stomach sleepers, meeting all your comfort and support needs.

settings.question: How do I choose the right Kusho product for me?
settings.answer: Pick the pillow that fits your sleeping position(side,back or stomach) and support needs(neck,back,travel). Reach out to our team anytime for assistance.

settings.question: Can Kusho cushions improve posture?
settings.answer: Yes. They provide targeted support for your spine, neck, and back, promoting better posture while sitting, sleeping, or travelling.

settings.question: Is there a warranty on Kusho products?
settings.answer: Yes. All Kusho products come with a standard warranty against only manufacturing defects.
